name: issue-explore-and-create
description: Search related GitHub issues, draft a repo-shaped issue, and file it with gh after explicit confirmation. Does not plan implementation.

inputs.name: idea
inputs.description: Prompt text for a future implementation idea, or a pasted feature-brief.

inputs.name: repository
inputs.description: Optional target repository as owner/name when the checkout is ambiguous.

inputs.name: issue-kind
inputs.description: Optional kind: feature, chore, docs, bug, or spec.

inputs.name: user-clarifications
inputs.description: Optional answers accumulated across clarification loops.

outputs.name: overlap-report
outputs.description: Related open and closed issues with links, plus whether drafting must stop.

outputs.name: issue-draft
outputs.description: Repository, title, labels, markdown body, and related links. Empty when drafting is blocked.

outputs.name: issue-url
outputs.description: Created issue URL and number. Empty until filing succeeds.

outputs.name: open-questions
outputs.description: Remaining questions at handoff. Blocking items first.
